title: Hybrid The Rescue Club (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the long iron is dead
The hybrid took its place, the rescue ahead
Easier to hit, son, easier to launch

[Verse 1]
Four hybrid replaces the four iron, son
Five hybrid for the five iron run
Greater forgiveness, lower center of gravity
Launches the ball higher with ease and gravity

[Pre-Chorus]
Swing the hybrid like a long iron, son
Not like a fairway wood, the work undone
Descending blow, ball middle of stance
Clean strike, slight divot, give it a chance

[Chorus]
Hybrid the rescue club, son
Long iron replacement, easy run
Mid stance, descending blow
Launches high, holds the green slow

[Verse 2]
Use the hybrid out of the rough
The wide sole glides through the tough stuff
Use it on long par threes, two hundred yards
Use it on lay ups, find the smart cards

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, every amateur should carry three hybrids
Drop the three four five iron, the rigids
Replace with three four five hybrid, son
Fifteen yards more carry, the rescue won

[Chorus]
Hybrid the rescue club, son
Long iron replacement, easy run
Mid stance, descending blow
Launches high, holds the green slow

[Outro]
Three four five hybrid, drop the long irons
Mid stance, descending, no environs
Launches high, holds the green
Thats my boy, smart and lean
